item.title: 2027 election: Labour Party, Obidients strongly consider options amid Peter Obi defection reports, see full details
item.description: LP and Peter Obi supporters (Obidients) are exploring their options amid speculation about the presidential hopeful’s possible defection ahead of the 2027 election.

item.title: What's next for Venezuela under the US oil blockade?
item.description: A US blockade of Venezuelan oil shipments could slash production and halve exports of the country's most valuable commodity, tipping its economy even deeper into crisis, experts say.

item.title: EU holds crunch summit on Russian asset plan for Ukraine
item.description: EU leaders gather in Brussels Thursday for a make-or-break summit on using frozen Russian assets for Ukraine -- with key player Belgium under pressure to drop its opposition. Ukraine has said Washington was "pressuring" the EU not to use the assets as they view them as a vital bargaining chip in winning over Russia.

item.title: Asian markets track Wall St lower as AI fears mount
item.description: Asian markets sank Thursday after another sell-off on Wall Street as worries over the tech sector's colossal spending on artificial intelligence continued to dog investor sentiment. Asian markets tracked the US losses, led by tech firms including Japan's Renesas and investment giant SoftBank.

item.title: ECB set to hold rates but debate swirls over future
item.description: The European Central Bank is expected to hold interest rates steady Thursday for its fourth meeting in a row as inflation remains in check, although debate is heating up about the path forward. Following a year-long series of cuts, the central bank for the 20 countries that use the euro has kept its key deposit rate on hold at two percent since July.

item.title: Trump vows economic boom, blames Biden in address to nation
item.description: President Donald Trump promised Americans an economic boom in an address to the nation on Wednesday, while blaming Democratic predecessor Joe Biden for high prices that have hit the Republican's popularity.

item.title: What to know about the EU-Mercosur deal
item.description: Squabbles over the EU-Mercosur trade deal are likely to punctuate a European Union summit in Brussels on Thursday. Agricultural unions have projected up to 10,000 protestors in Brussels on Thursday, including 4,000 from France.

item.title: Breaking: Burkina Faso releases 11 Nigerian Air Force personnel
item.description: The military government of Burkina Faso released 11 Nigerian Air Force personnel detained last week after diplomatic intervention by the Nigerian government.

item.title: "He don go copy Ibrahim Chatta": Lateef's massive film village gets fans talking
item.description: Nollywood Actor Lateef Adedimeji has joined a list of filmakers that owns film villlages as he unveiled his multi-billion-naira film village in Ekiti State.

item.title: "Change title of your new movie or else": Christian Association warns Ini Edo
item.description: The Christian Association of Nigeria (CAN) has taken a strong stance against the title of Ini Edo’s newly released movie, A Very Dirty Christmas.
